# Test fixtures

Everything here is INVENTED. `INVENTED_tender_99999999/` is a made-up tender (no real buyer, no real
contact details) and `INVENTED_model_answer.json` is a made-up model answer for it. Two quotes in the
answer are deliberately not in the text, and the technical specification holds a line that tries to
give the model an instruction, to test that document text is treated as data.
